displaySettings.languageDescription: UI language for this interface. Agent content and data stay untranslated.
displaySettings.showMachineNameDesc: On multi-machine deployments, show the host machine's name next to each agent row
displaySettings.showStatusDotDesc: Show a status color dot (running/idle/…) on each sidebar agent row; off by default to keep the list static and quiet
displaySettings.showActivityLineDesc: In wide-sidebar mode, show a second line of the agent's activity; off by default
displaySettings.showTerminatedDesc: Show terminated agents (red status dot) in the sidebar; off shows only live agents
displaySettings.showWeekdayDesc: Show the weekday in timeline card timestamps (e.g. Mon 14:30)
displaySettings.timeModeDesc: The time shown at the right of each agent row
displaySettings.timelineMaxWidthDesc: Max width of the conversation column as a fraction of the viewport ({min}%–{max}%), capped at 1280px so ultra-wide screens stay readable. The composer stays 48px narrower. Default {def}% = 768px on a 1920px screen.
displaySettings.collapseDetailsDesc: A newly-toggled work block starts collapsed instead of open. Flipping this (or the header's Details chip) expands/collapses every work block at once
displaySettings.usageBarWidthDesc: Width of the collapsed context-usage bar at the bottom of the composer; the expanded breakdown panel is unaffected
displaySettings.awaitingReplyDesc: Show a red dot + count badge in the sidebar for agents awaiting reply; off by default — check the Fleet page when you want to know
displaySettings.confirmTerminateDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when terminating an agent
displaySettings.confirmRestartDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when restarting an agent
displaySettings.confirmForceKillDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when force-killing (kill / SIGKILL) an agent

schedules.name: Name

presets.intro: A preset is a named config template (model, preloaded skills, plugin fields). Pick one in the spawn menu to start an agent from it — an explicit model chosen there still wins.

guide.describeTask: Describe an operations task — e.g. “install the linear MCP server on the gateway machine”

guide.intro: Ask Ava to operate the cluster — run or update it, switch tracks, manage MCP servers, install skills or plugins, tune anything not on this page.
